name: Janis Woolf
source: Commander Woolf of the Overture police’s Dragoon unit is a mage with unparalleled magic power. She has been in countless battles, and lived through them. But she may soon discover that her strength alone isn't enough to protect the kingdom of Overture and the people who live within its walls.
